## Exploring data + wrangling

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

### Loading the loaded data

```{r}
#| message: FALSE
patients <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_patients.tsv"))
samples <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_samples.tsv"))
mutations <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_mutations.tsv"))
```

### Cleaning data?

```{r}
patients |> view()
samples |> view()
mutations |> view()
```

### Combining some data

```{r}
survival_table <- full_join(patients,samples, by = 'PATIENT_ID')
survival_table |> select('PATIENT_ID','OS_STATUS','CANCER_TYPE', 'SEX','OS_MONTHS')

survival_table
```

```{r}
g1 <- ggplot(data = survival_table,
            mapping = aes(y = CANCER_TYPE,
                          x = OS_MONTHS,
                          color = SEX)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
g1
```

Calculate the percent of survival for each cancer type

```{r}
survival_percentage <- survival_table |> 
  group_by(CANCER_TYPE, SEX) |> 
  summarise(number_of_patients = n(),
  average_survival = mean(OS_MONTHS, na.rm = TRUE),
  alive = sum(OS_STATUS == '0:LIVING', na.rm = TRUE),
  survival_percent = alive / number_of_patients * 100)

g2 <- ggplot(data = survival_percentage,
             mapping = aes(x = CANCER_TYPE,
                           y = survival_percent,
                           fill = SEX)) + 
  geom_col(position = 'dodge')+
  labs (title = 'Survival percentage for each cancer type',
        x = 'Cancer type',
        y = 'Survival percent (%)')+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 20,
    hjust = 0.75))
g2

```

```{r}
survival_percentage <- survival_table |> 
  group_by(SEX) |> 
  summarise(
    number_of_patients = n(),
    alive = sum(OS_STATUS == '0:LIVING', na.rm = TRUE),

g3 <- ggplot(data = survival_percentage,
             mapping = aes(x = SEX,
                           y = survival_percent,

  geom_col(position = 'dodge')+
  labs (title = 'Survival percentage for each cancer type',
        x = 'Sex',
        y = 'Survival percent (%)')+

g3
```
